table.retrieve:
SELECT 	
	itemname= dbo.item.name, 
	dbo.itempacking.name, 
	dbo.prledger.prinvcode,
	dbo.prledger.purinvcode,
	dbo.prledger.date ,  
	dbo.prledger.remarks,
	dbo.prledger.discperc,  
	dbo.prledger.misccharges,  
	dbo.prledger.flatdisc,  
	dbo.prledger.salestax,  
	dbo.prledger.suppcode,  
	dbo.prdetail.icode,  
	dbo.prdetail.batch,  
	dbo.prdetail.expiry,  
	dbo.prdetail.packqty, 
	dbo.prdetail.looseqty, 
	dbo.prdetail.bonusqty, 
	dbo.prdetail.packunits, 
	dbo.prdetail.prprice,   
	dbo.prdetail.avgprice,    
	dbo.prdetail.discperc,   
	dbo.prdetail.unitsalestax,
	dbo.prdetail.gstperc,
	dbo.prledger.invgstperc1, 
	aliasname=CASE WHEN PrLedger.CustCode > 0 THEN (SELECT A.AliasName FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = PrLedger.CustCode) ELSE dbo.accounts.aliasname END,
	SupplierName=CASE WHEN PrLedger.CustCode > 0 THEN (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = PrLedger.CustCode) ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.accounts.name)) END,
	users=(SELECT users.username FROM users WHERE usercode=prledger.salesmancode),
	alias=item.customicode,
	saleprice=prdetail.packsaleprice/dbo.prdetail.packunits,
	PackCapacity = item.PackCapacity,
	AreaVolume = item.AreaVolume,
	PCS=ROUND(prdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6),
	Cartons= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CAST(((ROUND(prdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6)) / CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END) AS INT), 7, 0))) + ' : ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(((CAST(ROUND(prdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6) AS INT)) % CAST(CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END AS INT)), 7, 0))),
	POSTED=prledger.posted
	
FROM
	dbo.prledger,   
	dbo.prdetail,
	dbo.accounts,   
	item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)

WHERE	
	( dbo.prledger.prinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) and 
	( dbo.prledger.prinvcode = dbo.prdetail.prinvcode ) and  
	(dbo.prledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode) and 
	( prdetail.icode = item.icode )
ORDER By
	PrRowid

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum( unitsalestax * ( bonusqty  +  looseqty )  + round( c_amount  * 0.01* gstperc ,2) for all)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum(( looseqty  +  bonusqty )  *  saleprice  for all)

objects.name: c_overallsalestax
objects.expression: round((round(sum(round( c_amount,2) for all) * (1 -  prledger_discperc *  0.01 ) ,2 )  -  prledger_flatdisc ) *  invgstperc1 * 0.01, 2)

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round((round((round(sum(round( c_amount,2) for all) * (1 -  prledger_discperc *  0.01 ) ,2 )  -  prledger_flatdisc ) *  invgstperc1 * 0.01, 2)  + sum(c_salestaxval for all) ), f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -   prledger_flatdisc +   prledger_misccharges +  prledger_salestax, f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon')) + Round((round((round(sum(round( c_amount,2) for all) * (1 -  prledger_discperc *  0.01 ) ,2 )  -  prledger_flatdisc ) *  invgstperc1 * 0.01, 2)  + sum(c_salestaxval for all) ), f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))
